svg.title: Session 2 - One front door for every MCP server
svg.desc: Four decisions per MCP server: who consumes it, how it is exposed, where it runs and how teams find it. Clients call one API Management URL with a Microsoft Entra token; the gateway checks it and forwards to the Function (part A) or answers from REST operations turned into tools (part B, Preview). The gateway URL is registered in API Center (Preview), which the Foundry tool catalog (Preview) reads.
